item.title: Energetic Resilience
item.description: Energetic Resilience is a mindfulness skillset. How we think, feel & speak determines the outcome of what we focus on. With this awareness, you will learn the importance of cultivating energy vs. striving for the fixed outcome. By practicing easy techniques to optimise ones' daily energy levels, adapting to change becomes the new resilient normal.

item.title: Supercharge Your Success Thru the Powerful Brain-Wave State that No One Has Told You About
item.description: High-performance athletes and elite corporate executives have one thing in common: they use a brain-wave state not experienced in your typical workday. Join us to learn how to access this state and for a guided experience scientifically designed to transport you to this supercharged brain-wave state today, even if you have never meditated.

item.title: Building Local Mindfulness Communities
item.description: Many of us hunger for local connections with others who are passionate about mindfulness. Online gatherings and even in person conferences like Wisdom 2.0 are wonderful opportunities to engage with other like-minded people. But what if we could also have local mindfulness communities that brings together people I can see online AND In Person?

item.title: Get Unstuck! Using Mindfulness & Self-Awareness to Reach your Toughest Goals
item.description: In this powerful 60-minute session, you'll learn how to use mindfulness and self-awareness to identify and transform the beliefs and behaviors that are holding you back. You'll then design a clear, actionable plan that gets you unstuck and moves you towards your toughest goals.

item.title: Adopting a Mindful Approach in Organizations to Achieve Optimal Performance
item.description: Sustainable quality performance is enabled by taking a mindful approach to the way the organization operates. A mindful approach combines interpersonal, intrapersonal, technology, and process management components. Join George Pitagorsky, Jonathan Reynolds, and Jim Schaffer to explore, from multiple perspectives, a comprehensive approach.

item.title: Catalyzing Courageous Team Connectedness
item.description: How can teams build connectedness that lasts? How do we tap into our potential, authentically and together when challenged? In this interactive session we will explore how to facilitate our teams to mature to their next level of connectedness, becoming a sustainably high performing team.

item.title: Mindfulness For Those Who Don’t Do Meditation: The Pathfinder’s Question
item.description: An alternative mindfulness application for your clients or employees who don't do meditation. The Pathfinder's Question allows your people to use mindfulness in real time to address the situations, challenges, and goals that matter most to them, Overview and how to "test drive" the application included. (Duration: 22 min.)
